changelog: [Never Segment]: added five precise, generalized boundary conditions targeting the measured over-segmentation/wrong-boundary failures — elided/shared predicate, coreferential elided subject, repeated-connective list spans, causal chains (reason→reason→consequence), and parallel rhetorical clauses sharing an implied object — instead of banning any connective form outright.

[Decision Procedure]: expanded step 2's checklist to explicitly test for elided-predicate dependency, coreferential elided subject, repeated-connective lists, causal chains, and parallel rhetorical clauses, so the reject/accept test operationalizes the new Never-Segment conditions rather than only checking connective type.
